title: Finished stories no longer repeat in new worlds
summary: Once you've read a narrative story to the end, lecterns stop offering it, in any world, until you've finished every other story. Your reading now carries across worlds, so each new world brings you closer to finishing the stories and to discovering player-written ones.
highlights: A finished story stays out of lecterns until every story is finished
Finishing a story in one world unlocks its follow-up stories in every world
Player-written stories unlock based on how much you've read across all worlds
Re-read stories now start at letter 1 and continue in order
